title: The 2026 untouchable leaders report
discussion_signal: The post frames firms as structurally protected by pricing power, switching costs, technical bottlenecks, and control of critical inputs. It also supplies a counter-risk: investor narratives may confuse a strong position with permanent immunity from competition.
linked_research_question: How do concentration, ownership, bottlenecks, and switching costs shape prices, investment, labor, local access, and the possibility of entry or exit?
limits: Market-share and technical claims are not independently checked here
A list of firms does not establish causal market power
